description: Give a customer an active credit bundle: its credits are added to their balance and, unless create_invoice is false, a draft invoice for its price is made. Unlimited bundles cannot be granted as a balance. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

create_invoice.description: Also create a draft invoice for the price (default true).

name: grant_credit_bundle_plan
